title: Core System
description: Four reference-dependent images establishing a reusable future domestic visual system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the reusable Future Domestic anchor. Images 02-04 preserve the cabinetry geometry, appliance language, soft material palette, and lived-in storage logic while changing scene context and deliverable emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
